typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT [Recipient_Medicaid_ID]       ,[Last_Name]       ,[First_Name]       ,[Recipient_DOB]       ,[Billing_Prov_NPI]       ,[Billing_Prov_Name]       ,[Billing_Prov_NCPDP_Number]       ,[Ordering_Prov_NPI]       ,[Ordering_Prov_Name]       ,[Primary_Diagnosis]       ,[Prescription_Date]       ,[Service_Date]       ,[Therapeutic_Class-GCN]       ,[GSN_or_GPI]       ,[NDC_Code]       ,[Product_Name]       ,[Generic_Name]       ,[Metric_Qty_Dispensed_Rx]       ,[Strength]       ,[Days_Supply_Rx]       ,[Units_per_day]       ,[DEA_Class_Code]       ,[Rx_Refill_Number]       ,[Rx_Number]       ,[Rx_Claim_Number]       ,[Rx_Claim_Number_Sequence]       ,[Member_PA_Number]    FROM [DATA_EXCHANGE].[EXTRACT].[NV_TOC_RX_CLAIMS_EXTRACT]     WHERE [EXCD_ID] = ?   ORDER BY [Recipient_Medicaid_ID],[Rx_Claim_Number],[Rx_Claim_Number_Sequence]',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SourceTablePOMELOPHARMACYCLAIMSEXTRACT
SourceTablePOMELOPHARMACYCLAIMSEXTRACT sink(input(
		Ordering_Prov_NPI as string,
		Recipient_Medicaid_ID as string,
		Member_PA_Number as string,
		Rx_Number as string,
		Prescription_Date as string,
		Billing_Prov_NPI as string,
		NDC_Code as string,
		First_Name as string,
		Rx_Claim_Number_Sequence as string,
		Service_Date as string,
		Recipient_DOB as string,
		GSN_or_GPI as string,
		{Therapeutic_Class-GCN} as string,
		Ordering_Prov_Name as string,
		Metric_Qty_Dispensed_Rx as string,
		Rx_Refill_Number as string,
		Generic_Name as string,
		Billing_Prov_NCPDP_Number as string,
		Primary_Diagnosis as string,
		Product_Name as string,
		Billing_Prov_Name as string,
		Days_Supply_Rx as string,
		Rx_Claim_Number as string,
		DEA_Class_Code as string,
		Units_per_day as string,
		Last_Name as string,
		Strength as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Ordering_Prov_NPI,
		Recipient_Medicaid_ID,
		Member_PA_Number,
		Rx_Number,
		Prescription_Date,
		Billing_Prov_NPI,
		NDC_Code,
		First_Name,
		Rx_Claim_Number_Sequence,
		Service_Date,
		Recipient_DOB,
		GSN_or_GPI,
		{Therapeutic_Class-GCN},
		Ordering_Prov_Name,
		Metric_Qty_Dispensed_Rx,
		Rx_Refill_Number,
		Generic_Name,
		Billing_Prov_NCPDP_Number,
		Primary_Diagnosis,
		Product_Name,
		Billing_Prov_Name,
		Days_Supply_Rx,
		Rx_Claim_Number,
		DEA_Class_Code,
		Units_per_day,
		Last_Name,
		Strength)) ~> FlatFilePharmacyClaims
